measurementNotes.authoritative: These corrected metrics take precedence over original scoutCount/tool totals in raw capture files.
measurementNotes.timing: Completed runs measure prompt submission to observed primary terminal. Legacy timeout raw elapsedMs measures deadline detection only; normalized full end-to-end time is unknown, with deadlineElapsedMs reported separately.
measurementNotes.incomplete: Interrupted/aborted native recordedUsageLowerBound sums only observed usage; incomplete response or provider billing remains unknown. It is never used as full-task token savings.
measurementNotes.main: Actual xAI Responses SSE usage, reconciled with Host finalized usage and native Pi where available.
measurementNotes.scout: Actual provider-normalized Pi assistant usage in completed RPC sessions; no estimation.
measurementNotes.cache: promptTokens is uncached; cacheRead counted once in totalTokens; reasoning is output subset; cacheWrite unknown because xAI did not report it.
measurementNotes.interruption: Interrupted protocol-violation attempts have recovered native tool evidence, completed-request token lower bound only, and unknown exact elapsed/retries; excluded from valid A/B means.
measurementNotes.gap: Interrupted attempts have reconstructed native evidence, not full streaming capture. Normal completed/timeout attempts preserve subagent/stream plus native SDK/RPC evidence; per-run completeness is explicit.
measurementNotes.retries: Observed main/Scout retry events are counted when full child capture exists; provider-internal/model-selected tool retries remain unknown.

acceptanceFailures: safety interruption for tool availability audit
